evidence_boundary: Synthesis from prior conversation, partial public documentation; no exhaustive example audit; cross-index labels not unique discoveries.

records.title: Architecture and layout
records.principle: Choose surface by task, object, risk and input; prefer conventional direct controls for deterministic actions.
records.acceptance: Retain focus, scroll, context and keyboard access; responsive fallback for panels; compare time/errors with non-AI flow.

records.title: Discovery and input
records.principle: Make capabilities and input scope discoverable; distinguish suggestions from selected context.
records.acceptance: Expose editable/removable context, clear permissions and accessible input labels; never silently add private sources.

records.title: Editing and refinement
records.principle: Make edits bounded, inspectable and recoverable; preserve unrelated content.
records.acceptance: Test partial selection, acceptance/rejection, undo, focus, failure and preservation of untouched regions.

records.title: Results and generative UI
records.principle: Render the useful object, not just prose; validate structured output and distinguish drafts from saved objects.
records.acceptance: Schema validation, source attribution, safe actions, keyboard navigation, cancel/retry, fallback to readable text.

records.title: Agentic UX
records.principle: Expose actual plan, scope, status, permissions, consequences and completion evidence; approval for consequential actions.
records.acceptance: Simulate failure, permission expansion, cancellation, timeout, retry and partial completion; do not fake progress or reasoning.

records.title: AI design system
records.principle: Extend existing semantic components instead of replacing them; AI labels should convey real provenance.
records.acceptance: Document anatomy, states, keyboard, screen-reader names, focus, validation and design tokens. No decorative AI icon alone as disclosure.

records.title: Motion and states
records.principle: Use motion to communicate real state changes and preserve spatial continuity, not simulate activity.
records.acceptance: Respect reduced motion; provide non-motion and non-hover alternatives; measure progress only when available; stable geometry.

records.title: Trust and human control
records.principle: Communicate capabilities before use, relevance during use, correction when wrong and adaptation over time.
records.acceptance: Check sources and uncertainty, accessible dismissal/correction, inspect/edit memory, revocable permissions and safe manual fallback.

records.title: Visual and responsive design
records.principle: No mandatory AI aesthetic; optimize hierarchy, density, contrast and conventional affordances.
records.acceptance: Check contrast, zoom, reflow, keyboard, touch, screen reader, state differentiation; no color-only meaning.

records.title: Antipatterns
records.principle: Avoid unnecessary AI, opaque automation and irreversible actions; do not mistake decoration for utility.
records.acceptance: Compare conventional alternative, test dismissal, correction, transparent scope, actual status, and recovery.
